purpose: Check a necessary upper bound for the frozen local-pair gate using only frozen subject polarity coverage. This does not generate or inspect any year-gap pair.

frozen_thresholds.pair_definition_for_later_step: same subject, same preassigned axis, opposite polarity, distinct years, abs gap 1-5

necessary_condition: A subject can only be pairable later if it already has at least one eligible positive and at least one eligible negative event. Therefore both-polarity subject count is a strict upper bound on eventual 1-5y pairable-subject count.
fail_rule: If the both-polarity upper bound is below any frozen minimum, stop before pair generation and add a whole new DEV roster wave under a separately frozen deterministic protocol.
